assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: standalone premium dashboard header background, NOT a screenshot or UI mockup. Wide panoramic 3:1 landscape composition. Flat orthographic front view, centered and symmetric overall. Deep midnight navy #05121d background fading seamlessly at edges. Large empty dark center (middle 45% horizontally, middle 45% vertically) reserved for a title added later; NO TEXT, NO NUMBERS, NO ICONS, NO LOGOS, NO CHARTS, NO UI PANELS, NO WATERMARK. Keep most decorative material on left/right wings and along a low horizontal rail. Deliberate, exquisite restrained design with crisp traceable contour edges, minimal bloom. One main sharp thin luminous rim on each wing must form a continuous uninterrupted visible contour; important because SVG animation will follow this real rim exactly. Direction: AURORA FOLDED GLASS. Translucent celadon, emerald and turquoise layered glass ribbons, elegant shallow S-curves sweeping from the far left and right at mid-height down toward the lower center. Clean sinuous curves, subtly iridescent glass thickness, luminous mint rim. Avoid mechanical angular frame, avoid star field. Refined optical sculpture, quiet mint and teal, not purple.
